title: Union of Two Sorted Arrays
oneLiner: Return all distinct values of both arrays in ascending order.

approaches.intuition: An ordered set removes duplicates and sorts.
approaches.takeaway: Ignores that the arrays are sorted.
approaches.name: Ordered Set
approaches.label: Brute
steps: st.insert(x) for every x in a and b

approaches.intuition: Both arrays are sorted, so the smaller front value is next.
approaches.takeaway: Compare with result.back() to skip duplicates.
approaches.whyBetter: The set re-sorts sorted data; one merge pass does it.
approaches.name: Two Pointers
approaches.label: Optimal
steps: Walk i over a and j over b, taking the smaller as x

constraintsHint: M, N up to 10^5 -> O(M + N) is ideal
recognize: Two sorted inputs + union -> two pointers.
pitfalls: Pushing both copies when a[i] == b[j].
Not checking result.back() on the tail.
